protocol_description: Comparative evaluation of SPOTER V2 (79 classes) vs SPOTER V3 (100-class architecture) on identical held-out test samples. Shared-class comparison evaluates the 79 common classes. Protocol A (Restricted Subspace) masks V3 logits to the 79 shared classes for an exact closed-set comparison with V2. Protocol B (Unrestricted Full-Space) ranks V3 across all 100 output logits.
